title: Why The Online Guru Scam is Worse Than You Thought
summary: Reacts to social-media guru clips: faked lifestyles, calculator math, high-ticket sales coaching as the new MLM, bought followers and inflated creator incomes.

assertions.quote: your wallet's just going to be lighter and all that you're going to have to show for it is a poorly made course
these guys sell courses selling that they've done something they've never done. They've just gotten good at marketing and sales and hype
If you've ever made $1,095.11, you can make 400 grand because I just showed you how easy it is.

verdicts.note: Dividing a target by days is arithmetic, not a method; median earnings show most people cannot sustain such a daily figure.

assertions.quote: High ticket sales has become the new MLM. Everyone's a coach. Everyone's building a team.
either you get absolutely no engagement from your followers or they were bought in the first place to make you look legitimate

verdicts.note: Follower purchasing services are widely available and engagement ratios expose inflated counts.

assertions.quote: The average OF creator makes about $150 a month.
